records.title: Ritz Framework & Tech Stack Selection
records.context: Need a clean, maintainable, responsive application for a water refilling station.
records.decision: Use HTML5, Vanilla CSS3, Vanilla JS ES Modules, Hash Routing, GitHub Pages, Firebase Auth/Firestore/Functions.
records.consequences: Zero framework bloat, high speed, cheap hosting, strict Cloud Function security boundary.

records.title: Authenticated Customer Accounts & Portal Override
records.context: Override older manuscript limitation to allow digital ordering.
records.decision: Customers have self-registered authenticated accounts with a dedicated customer portal.
records.consequences: Customers can submit delivery orders, track status, view receipts and jug balances online.

records.title: PayMongo Backend Integration
records.context: Online payment requirement for customer orders.
records.decision: Integrate PayMongo exclusively via trusted Cloud Functions. Secret keys never leave backend.
records.consequences: Prevents client payment forgery and secret leakage.

records.title: Single Owner & Explicit Role Boundaries
records.decision: Exactly one protected OWNER account. Only OWNER manages employee accounts/roles.
records.consequences: Administrators cannot alter staff roles or elevate permissions.

records.title: Quantity-Based Company Jug Accountability
records.context: Tracking company-owned water jugs held by customers.
records.decision: Track jug movements (RELEASED, RETURNED, ADJUSTMENT) on a quantity basis per customer. No barcodes/QR/RFID.
records.consequences: Simple, accurate inventory and customer jug balance balance checks without hardware complexity.

records.title: Immutable Finalized Sales & No Order Cancellation
records.context: Prevent financial fraud and audit tampering.
records.decision: Finalized sales cannot be edited, deleted, voided, or refunded. Delivery orders cannot be cancelled once confirmed. Owner/Admin can append secondary correction records.
